messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 429/500 rates observed for "ratecap-policy-service" in eu-west-1 starting ~1912345600. Trigger: 5m error rate > 3x baseline. Paging eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @sam: release/ratecap-policy v3.1.4 -> canary-eu (pods: policy-canary-3). image: registry.redwood/v3.1.4

alice (eng-oncall): i'm on it — seeing client reports for tokens being rejected, lots of 429s to /v1/usage/check. Can someone paste the canary logs?

sam (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. 
```
2026-03-15T09:34:12Z policy-canary-3 INFO receive request user=acct-987 path=/v1/usage/check tokens=1
2026-03-15T09:34:12Z policy-canary-3 WARN ratecap: deny user=acct-987 reason=quota_exceeded
2026-03-15T09:34:13Z policy-canary-3 ERROR token-accounting mismatch: request_id=abc123 expected_balance=200 actual_balance=-1
```

ben (eng-sre): ugh negative balance. That smells like token-accounting hook didn't honor exemptions. Are internal service tokens (billing, telemetry) in the new exemption list?

sam (eng-runtime): quick grep on deployed config shows exemptions: `["health-check","billing-service"]` — but telemetry-service is missing. Our prod exemption list should include `telemetry-service` and `internal-admin`. Looks like an overlay in the Helm chart for canary-eu dropped two entries.

alice (eng-oncall): rolling back canary now. @deploy-bot rollback release/ratecap-policy v3.1.3 -> canary-eu

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by @alice. rolling back 3 pods... status: in_progress

carla (product): any customer impact? we got two support DMs already.

dave (customer-success): currently seeing 6 mid-tier customers in EU reporting degraded generation (timeout/429). 1 enterprise (ACME Corp) on Dedicated saw increased errors for ~8m. CS notified them.

ben (eng-sre): mitigation step: temporarily flip feature flag `ratecap-enforce-canary` -> false for eu region while we investigate. That should stop the new enforcement path.

alice (eng-oncall): flipping flag now: `flagsctl set ratecap-enforce-canary eu-west-1 false` -> success :white_check_mark:

sam (eng-runtime): rollback finished. canary pods on v3.1.3, metrics trending back to baseline. Confirming 429s dropping.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 1912345678 — mitigation applied: rollback + feature-flag flip. Severity: P2 -> investigating root cause.

ben (eng-sre): preliminary RCA: v3.1.4 introduced a config merge change that reads exemptions from `values.policy.exemptions` but our chart overlay for canary used `values.policy.exempt` (typo). Helm overlay merge set `exempt` leaving `exemptions` empty — default config stricter, so internal tokens got treated as normal users -> over-throttle.

sam (eng-runtime): reproducing locally: apply overlay with the typo -> `exemptions` empty -> negative balances in accounting path when exempted counters not applied. Patching fix in a branch now.

alice (eng-oncall): timeline capture:
- 09:33:12 deploy started (v3.1.4)
- 09:34:00 first elevated 429s seen
- 09:35:10 pager fired
- 09:36:00 rollback + flag flip initiated
- 09:41:00 rollback complete, traffic stabilized

carla (product): customer impact summary for ops report: affected ~6 mid-tier accounts and 1 enterprise for ~8m window. No data loss. Some realtime features degraded. CS to follow up via templates.

dave (customer-success): sending customer notes now, will escalate ACME rep to AE and postmortem kickoff if requested.

ben (eng-sre): short-term action items:
- merge hotfix to restore correct key `exemptions` and re-deploy canary after smoke tests (owner: sam)
- add helm integration test to catch unknown keys in overlay (owner: eng-qa)
- add alert for sudden spike in accounting negative-balance errors (owner: eng-sre)
- run a scan of all overlays in other regions for the typo (owner: eng-infra)

sam (eng-runtime): pushed PR #5421 with fix + unit test. will request canary redeploy to a small set after QA signoff.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: created incident ticket INC-2026-0342, assigned to eng-sre.

alice (eng-oncall): handoff to ben for postmortem and follow-ups. i'll update incident timeline in pager duty then sign off.

ben (eng-sre): taking over. please add any extra customer notes here. we'll schedule a postmortem and coordinate permanent rollback gating (CI/helm checks).

carla (product): can we also add a doc snippet for CS: quick steps to communicate degraded experience and expected recovery time? I'll draft.

sam (eng-runtime): quick smoke after patch looked good. will coordinate canary retries + 15m watch before promoting.

alice (eng-oncall): thanks team. closing on-call handoff. :handshake:

ben (eng-sre): final notes for incident record: root cause = helm overlay key typo leading to missing exemptions; impact = short-lived 429s for ~6 customers + 1 enterprise, duration ~8m; mitigation = rollback to v3.1.3 + feature flag disable; long-term fix = helm test + CI lint + overlay auditing + alerting.

sam (eng-runtime): PR merged 1912346100, canary redeploy scheduled 1912346200 after QA.

dave (customer-success): all affected customers notified, ACME assigned to AE, no escalations beyond ticket yet.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 1912345678 — status: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.
